title: Plugin action
description: One action a Plugin offers: its name, a label and optional help text for operators, the inputs it takes, at most 16, and its display choices: whether it appears in the right-click menu, and whether its listed places show on the map by default. The Command Interface builds the action's form, menu entry, and result view from these. Its answer is a plugin.result or plugin.failure, the same for every action.

examples.label: Find buildings
examples.help_text: Lists every building in the area from OpenStreetMap.
